_about: Answers of POST /api/webhooks/gmaps-extension, as the contract tests assert them (tests/integration/webhooks/extension-ingest.test.ts). Values are fictitious.

401 revoked token.message: This ingestion token was revoked. Create a new token in the Extension hub.

403 web origin.message: Web pages cannot send extension batches.

403 other extension.message: This token is bound to another Chrome extension id. Check the allowed extension id in the Extension hub.

409 same batch id, other body.message: This event or batch id was already received with different content. Send it with a new id.

413 more than 200 records.message: A batch holds at most 200 records. Split it.

422 no valid record.message: No record of this batch is valid. Nothing was stored.

429 rate limited.message: Too many batches from this token. The bridge retries later.
